task.description: Fix GH #500 (ISS-0172, MAJOR): src/lua_test_root.zig's type-only pin pattern (`_ = lua.instruction_limiter.InstructionLimiter;`) does not force struct field-type resolution or function-body analysis, so zig build test-lua reports green while src/lua/instruction_limiter.zig:39 (a discarded c_int return value from lua_sethook) and src/lua/memory_limiter.zig:13 (std.Thread.Mutex, which does not exist in Zig 0.16) both contain hard compile errors that are never surfaced. This affects 8 test roots using the same pattern: src/lua_test_root.zig, src/simulation_test_root.zig, src/transition_test_root.zig, src/oidc_test_root.zig, src/oidc_jit_test_root.zig, src/config_idp_test_root.zig, src/core_modules_test_root.zig, src/repository_test_root.zig. This is a two-part fix: (1) FIX THE 2 REAL BUGS this gap hid -- instruction_limiter.zig's discarded c_int return (use `_ = bindings.lua_sethook(...)` or handle the return value properly per whatever the correct behavior is) and memory_limiter.zig's nonexistent std.Thread.Mutex field (Zig 0.16's actual Mutex type -- check std.Thread's current API, it likely moved or was renamed); (2) FIX THE PIN PATTERN across all 8 test roots to a form that forces both struct field-type resolution (e.g. `_ = @sizeOf(T);` or `_ = @typeInfo(T).@"struct".fields;`) and function-body analysis (a real, non-comptime-eliminated call or @TypeOf-based reference), per the issue's own acceptance criteria. Verify by DELIBERATE MUTATION for BOTH failure shapes (a bad field type in a struct, and a statement error in an unreferenced function) -- the target must go red in both cases, and you must actually perform this mutation test, not just reason about it. Also correct src/lua_test_root.zig's header comment, which currently overclaims what its prior mutation-verification covered. This is a real, well-specified fix with concrete mechanical steps across 8 files plus 2 genuine bug fixes -- work through it methodically, file-by-file. If the pin-pattern fix and the tools/lint_test_wiring.py enhancement (flagging type-only pins) require a non-trivial design decision about exactly which @typeInfo/@sizeOf incantation generalizes cleanly across all 8 files' different type shapes, route to CODE-DESIGNER; if it's mechanical enough to do directly, you may implement yourself and route straight to TEST-RUNNER -- use your judgment, explain either way.
acceptance_criteria: instruction_limiter.zig c_int discard fixed with correct handling
memory_limiter.zig std.Thread.Mutex fixed to whatever Zig 0.16 actually provides
Pin pattern fixed across all 8 named test roots to force both struct field-type resolution and function-body analysis
Deliberate mutation test ACTUALLY PERFORMED for both failure shapes (bad field type, statement error in unreferenced function) -- target confirmed to go red in both cases
tools/lint_test_wiring.py enhanced to flag a test root whose pins are type-only
src/lua_test_root.zig header comment corrected to accurately state what mutation shapes were tested
zig build exits 0 after all fixes (the 2 real bugs are now fixed, not just detected)
